decisions.reason: Height-adjustable executive desks fit the post-pandemic demand for flexible, representative workplaces, so the option's upside is still being realized and holding it costs little for a multi-model line.
The carpet floor cushions remain a niche accessory with unclear value after several years, but they reuse rug materials at low holding cost, so keeping the option is still cheap.
The sofa had only weak emphasis on the website and is a plausible candidate for portfolio pruning, but it sits close to the core upholstery business and costs little to maintain.
The high standing table complements the office and conference range at low incremental cost and benefits from the trend toward flexible workplaces, so abandoning it is not yet justified.

The rug collection is a strategic flagship that supports the move toward international interiors and feeds the cushion line, so management keeps this growth option open despite its distance from the core.
